### network
config interface 'svc_mgmt'
	option device 'br_mgmt'
	option proto 'static'
	option ipaddr '10.1.0.1'
	option netmask '255.255.255.0'

config device 'br_mgmt'
	option name 'br_mgmt'
	option type 'bridge'
	option ports 'eth1'
	option mtu '1500'

### firewall
config zone 'zone_mgmt'
	option name 'mgmt'
	option network 'svc_mgmt'
	option input 'ACCEPT'
	option output 'ACCEPT'
	option forward 'REJECT'

config rule 'allow_dhcp_mgmt'
	option name 'Allow-DHCP-mgmt'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '67'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_dns_mgmt'
	option name 'Allow-DNS-mgmt'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option proto 'tcp udp'
	option dest_port '53'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

config rule 'allow_ntp_mgmt'
	option name 'Allow-NTP-mgmt'
	option src 'mgmt'
	option proto 'udp'
	option dest_port '123'
	option target 'ACCEPT'

### dhcp
config dhcp 'svc_mgmt'
	option interface 'svc_mgmt'
	option start '101'
	option limit '154'
	option leasetime '12h'
	list dhcp_option '42,10.1.0.1'
	list interface_name 'svc_mgmt'

### rsyslog
### umdns
config umdns 'umdns'
	option enabled '1'
	option jail '1'
	list network 'svc_mgmt'

### mdns_repeater
config mdns_repeater 'main'
	option enabled '1'
	list interface 'br_mgmt'

### rsyslog.conf collector block
